[Speaker Notes: We know that Consumer Intelligence is the foundation of Skechers’ growth success. Why we’re here today is to help you achieve this through these three pillars:
Maximize Your Investment: Our primary goal is to help Skechers maximize your current investment with Salesforce, and we unlock this through a Unified Global Consumer Profile that allows you to deliver hyper-personalized messaging at scale to your consumers. 
Unlock Agentic AI: By leveraging Agentic AI, we are creating personalized, intelligent interactions that are conversational with the consumer that can think and act on behalf of your brand via an Intelligent Agent Network, that’s 24/7/365.
Cross-Channel Global Scale: This hyper-personalization we’re speaking of can be unlocked at Global Scale through this Unified Global Consumer Profile, meaning whether a consumer is in LA or London, the experience remains seamless and world-class, providing 1:1 interactions anywhere with your brand. 
What we’re here to show you today is how we take these three pillars and simultaneously put them into a real-life Sketchers consumer journey that will move the needle on: Awareness, Acquisition, Conversion, and Retention. 
Now, I’m going to pass this over to Aubrey, who will bring this vision to life.]
